comparison.objective: Load five glazed pots into a kiln with clearance from pots, posts, and walls.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual batch-layout planning and collision-free placement.
comparison.success_condition: Each upright pot earns credit only with 2 cm clearance from pots/posts and 1.5 cm from walls; any kiln contact invalidates the load. Stability tolerances are not otherwise specified.
comparison.reason: Clearance-constrained packing is meaningfully different from impact force control, sacrificial fracture, and containment of millimetre-scale debris.
